question: What comes with an escape room kit?
answer: Each escape room kit comes with the following:
items: Detailed instructions for assembling the room, include a list of materials to purchase.
Suggestions of additional (optional) materials and ideas to theme the space and add to the experience.
Files to download and print. If you are supporting blind players, you will need access to a braille printer.
Digital components that will make use of a provided phone, tablet or laptop.
Orientation materials to introduce the players and prepare them for the room and the theme.
Useful tips and hints for running a successful Escape Room, including specific instructions on resetting the room and packing the materials for shipping, travel or storage.

question: Can people who are blind or deaf-blind play?
answer: Yes, we have playtested with blind participants to ensure they can participate. Deaf-blind players are supported through a braille printouts of audio and other content. We also use tactile feedback on most of our puzzles and provide some tips for orienting visually- or cognitively-impaired players around the room before starting.

question: How long does it take to build an escape room?
answer: In general, it will take a few hours to assemble one of these kits once you've purchased the materials. We recommend setting up and playtesting the room a few times beforehand.

question: How long does it take to play an escape room?
answer: In general, our escape rooms will take between 15-40 mintues to play. However, this depends on several factors:
items: How many people are in a group?
How experienced your participants are at escape rooms or puzzles?
How well your groups work together?
How spread out the puzzle pieces are in the room?
How well are certain clues hidden?
closing: Each of our kits allow for an optional puzzle to be purchased and built, which will also extend the play time.
